Chapter 1322 - 7: Successfully Obtained

Chapter 1322: Chapter 7: Successfully Obtained

In the eyes of countless human civilization evolvers, it’s absolutely an unprecedented precious resource, a legendary rare treasure.

Even for twelfth rank evolvers, it’s a treasure they have never seen before. Even the peerless Great Saints of the Chaos Realm, at most, explore the dimensional gaps around the Chaos Void. Going further is impossible.

And the spoils Lin Yuan brought back this time were all obtained from regions those peerless Great Saints could never explore in their lifetimes.

...

"Nightmare Fruit."

Lin Yuan looked at the greatest harvest of this journey.

The other spoils were not considered precious to the thirteenth-rank time beings.

Only this Nightmare Fruit was exceptionally coveted, even by the powerful time beings.

This is evident from the plotting and planning by time beings like ’Thousand-faced River’ and ’Ling Hangui’.

Time beings have high standards and wouldn’t be drawn to intervene without immense value.

Observing future timelines also requires effort. To observe a large number of future timelines for the Nightmare Fruit, eliminating many other factors, is indeed a considerable expense.

"Refine it."

Lin Yuan did not hesitate.

Such a rare and precious treasure as the Nightmare Fruit is naturally best used on himself.

As for trading it away? He would only consider it after it became useless to him, and even then, he would try to trade it with his own people.

Buzzing sounds accompanied Lin Yuan as he continually refined it, and a thread of his mind began to fall into countless nightmares.

Layer upon layer of nightmares continuously tempered Lin Yuan’s mental will, causing his previously stagnant mental will to rise rapidly again.

...

While refining the Nightmare Fruit.

Lin Yuan was also comprehending the other six thirteenth-rank inheritances created by ’Lord Mo Xu’.

These six thirteenth-rank inheritances, standing alongside "Infinite Void," are considered by ’Lord Mo Xu’ as the road of the Time Lord.

"’Soul Fantasy Realm’?"

Lin Yuan spent several days to fully understand it.

At Lin Yuan’s current level, the six extreme thirteenth-rank inheritances are not very useful.

Most improvements have already been achieved. Lin Yuan’s endless Constant Sand Particle Worlds nurturing the soul and mind had reached their pinnacle, so enhancements were limited.

However, even if they weren’t very useful, they still had basic reference value.

"Lord Mo Xu’s path has considerable potential. Once able to become a Time Lord, it might be quite powerful among the lords."

Lin Yuan evaluated.

But wanting to advance in seven major aspects simultaneously and thus step into the lord level is very difficult.

"Infinite Void," "Soul Fantasy Realm," and other seven inheritances require creating a theoretical seventh layer.

Currently, ’Lord Mo Xu’ hasn’t created even one, so becoming a Time Lord is still far off.

"Mental will? Soul? Physical body?"

Lin Yuan carefully contemplated, integrating the core essence of the six inheritances into his own path.

...

The second source world.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

"Martial Tao...."

Lin Yuan’s deep gaze looked towards the entire source world.

Ten thousand years ago, Lin Yuan made a deal with the Eternal Sect, part of which included spreading a branch of his martial arts evolution road.

Although the second source world experienced a demonic plague, greatly reducing the number of cultivators.

It couldn’t compare with the first source world and the Chaos Void.

But a starved camel is larger than a horse.

Ultimately, it’s an entire source world.

Today, after more than ten thousand years of development.

The Martial Tao also thrived among various Holy Sects.

Countless cultivators embarked on the path of Martial Tao, continuously strengthening the ’anchor.’

"The infinite Constant Sand Particle Worlds of my other two true self avatars have been almost entirely developed," "Infinite Void’s" sixth layer has been completely practiced, and only the third layer of Chaotic Taiji Dao remains before attempting to impact the thirteenth rank."

Lin Yuan silently contemplated.

Regarding impacting the thirteenth rank, the specific tests trapped in the time cycle, Lin Yuan was unable to observe through future timelines.

So-called time cycling involves the supreme rule operation of endless dimensions, at least equivalent to fourteenth-rank means.

It would be obscured by the invisible supreme rule operation.

A thirteenth-rank time being cannot breach this obscuration.

If a thirteenth-rank could break through this obscuration, then time beings wouldn’t be so rare.

"With my current preparations, it’s stable."

Lin Yuan was reassured in his heart.

Encompassing the Chaos Void, the first source world, and the second source world, the anchor formed by countless Martial Tao cultivators in these three top-dimensional spaces, Lin Yuan didn’t know how ’solid’ it was.

Besides the above, there were many other dimensional spaces at a lower level. These were the ones Lin Yuan initially traversed, also widely spreading Martial Tao.

Additionally, Lin Yuan contemplated myriad laws, one law comprehends a hundred laws, so even when faced with a previously unencountered test, he could quickly derive a way through.

Finally, the employment of the essence of runes, thinking creates runes, even while trapped in a time cycle, he could still use operation.

"Perhaps my near certainty of crossing into the thirteenth rank is also because of these thorough preparations?"

Lin Yuan thought quietly in his heart.

...

Outside the Chaos Void.

Mystical dimensional gap.

After hundreds of years of traveling.

The Taiji Primordial Spirit finally reached the location of the Yin Yang Twin Flowers.

"Still no timeline with any time beings intervening, it’s safe."

Lin Yuan looked toward the distant ’spectacle.’

A towering iceberg stood, immersed in extreme cold, enough to totally freeze a peerless Great Saint of the Chaos Realm.

Nearby was a vermillion volcano, overflowing with supreme Yang Flame Power, permeating in all directions.

The extreme cold of Yin and supreme Yang Flame Power continuously collided, touched, and dissipated, gradually forming a range of Yin Yang symbiosis in the contact area of the iceberg and volcano.

Here Yin is Yang.

Yang is Yin.

"The dimensional gap is indeed magical."

Lin Yuan marveled in his heart, amazed that such a broad spectrum of Yin Yang symbiosis could also be nurtured.

Though Yin and Yang evolved from chaos, these opposing energies almost couldn’t merge without corresponding methods.

Lin Yuan’s Taiji Dao was also completely realized after thoroughly understanding Taiyang and Taiyang Pole Extreme and Taiyin Pole Extreme.

It eventually evolved through repeated traversing.

The current spectacle of Yin Yang symbiosis, though different from Taiji Dao, shares many similar aspects.

It offers substantial guidance.

"Yin Yang Twin Flowers, born in the symbiotic range of iceberg and volcano."

Lin Yuan looked toward the junction area of extreme Yin and Yang Power, where a mystical flower containing both Yin Yang aura blossomed.

The iceberg and volcano also nurtured many lifeforms. These lifeforms were innately powerful, able to be born in environments that could freeze and obliterate ordinary peerless Great Saints. Anything slightly weaker couldn’t survive.

"It’s safe to act."

Before taking action, Lin Yuan carefully reviewed numerous future timelines again for prudence.

In fact, neither the iceberg nor the volcano had reached the thirteenth rank level. Time beings, encountering them, wouldn’t bother to act.

Yet Lin Yuan’s path bore resemblance. The iceberg and volcano were born within the dimensional gap environment and embodied a trace of supreme rule operation, hence useful to Lin Yuan.

Swoosh.

Lin Yuan stretched out his hand.

Reaching toward the distant iceberg and volcano.

...

Inside the iceberg and volcano.

Countless extreme Yin beings and extreme Yang beings fervently eyed the Yin Yang junction.

"Holy Flower, the Holy Flower is blooming."

Numerous extreme Yin and Yang beings couldn’t help but shout, looking at the Yin Yang Twin Flower slowly blossoming there.

The Yin Yang Twin Flower, similarly nurturing Yin Yang Power, was a sacred object for both extreme Yin and Yang beings, begging for worship.

At this moment——

Countless extreme Yin and Yang beings suddenly noticed that the sky outside the dimensional gap grew dim.

A gigantic hand, large enough to cover the sky, slowly reached toward the iceberg and volcano.

The iceberg and volcano perpetually emitted cold and flame power, but in the face of that gigantic hand, it had no resistance whatsoever.

Lin Yuan retracted his right hand, and the towering iceberg and volcano obediently hovered between his palms.

The Yin Yang Twin Flowers were obtained.
